SIDBI Working Capital Term Loan

A working capital loan facility offered by SIDBI to eligible micro, small and medium enterprises to meet operational funding requirements.

Purpose

To finance the working capital gap of manufacturing and service sector MSMEs.

Eligibility

Existing MSME borrowers in operation for at least 3 years with satisfactory repayment track record.

Loan Amount

Up to Rs. 200 lakh, subject to appraisal of the borrower's working capital requirement.

Rate of Interest

Interest rate is linked to SIDBI's benchmark lending rate and is decided on a case-to-case basis at the time of sanction.

Repayment

Repayable over a tenure of up to 5 years including a moratorium period, as decided at the time of sanction.

Collateral

Primary security is a hypothecation of current assets; collateral security requirement depends on the loan amount and risk assessment.

Documents Required

  • KYC documents of the enterprise and promoters
  • Last 3 years' audited financial statements
  • GST returns
